tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya'i sgos sgrub ha la nag po gnod byed phog 'gyel bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru karma kro dhā ya/
'dir khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya'i rgyun khyer nyams su len par 'dod pas/ gtor mchod sogs bsham/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan lag bdun ni/
dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// mchog gi byang chub sems bskyed do// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig pa bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskul// dge tshogs bla med rgyur bsngo 'o//
mtshams gcad ni/
hūm̐/ khro bo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// ye shes lha nyid ma gtogs pa// 'jig rten rigs gyur log 'dren rnams// bka' las ma 'da' mtshams chod cig /
mchod rdzas rnams/

rang bzhin stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i bhañja'i nang du mchod yon me tog bdug spos/ sman raka gtor ma mchod pa'i sprin phung bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ar+ghaṃ
nas/
shab+da pañca rak+ta ba liṃ ta sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐/
bskyed rim ni/

ngang nyid chos kyi dbyings nyid las// 'gro la brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom// stong dang snying rje zung 'jug las// e las byung ba'i chos 'byung klong*// rak+ta'i rba klong 'phyo zhing 'khrugs// ru tra zhing gi lhu dum 'phyo// bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i lte ba la// hūm̐ las sras mchog kī la ya// dug chen ha la ha la'i mdog /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus srin zhal// dur khrod 'bar ba'i cha lugs rdzogs// g.yas gnyis rtse dgu rtse lnga 'phyar// g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ gsor// mtha' gnyis seng ldeng phur bu sgril// spu gri'i sgro gshog nam mkhar gdengs// sku smad phur gzugs lcags sreg bzhin// dmar po bdud bzhi'i snying la btsugs// ye shes me phung dbus nyid nas// drag sngags sgrog cing mtshon char 'beb// dpral mgrin snying khar oṃ āḥhūm̐// de las 'od 'phros khro bo'i tshogs// nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs te// bdag la thim pas gzi byin bskyed//
spyan 'dren mchod bstod sogs ni/

hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya// mthu rtsal 'byin pa'i dus la bab// sprul pa 'gyed pa'i dus la bab// bdag dang dbyer med brtan bzhugs nas// rtags dang mtshan ma ston pa dang*// phrin las drag po'i dngos grub stsol// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// hūm̐/ sras mchog khro bo'i lha tshogs la// me tog la sogs phyi mchod 'bul// dbang lnga la sogs nang mchod 'bul// sman raka gtor gsum sbyor sgrol mchod// blo 'das de bzhin nyid kyi ngang*// mchod pa mchod byed spros bral rol// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ
nas/
shab+da sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐
gis mchod/

hūm̐/ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya// srid par 'khyams pa'i sems can thams cad kun// dbyer med sku gsung thugs su sgrol mdzad pa'i// sras mchog kī la ya la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /thugs kar nyi steng mthing nag hūm̐// mthar bskor drag sngags phreng ba ni// gnam lcags 'bar ba lta bus bskor// bzlas pa sngags kyi phreng ba las// mtshon cha 'khor lo me dpung 'phros// bdud bzhi 'gong po spun dgu dang*// dregs pa rgyal 'gong log 'dren rnams// sha dum nyi le gzhob thul le// gzugs phung rdul bzhin brlags nas kyang*// rnam shes dwangs ma'i tshe bcud kun// srog la bstims pas dpa' brjid rgyas// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya gnod byed 'byung po'i snying la mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ
brgya phrag stong ci rigs bzla'o// mthar rdzogs rim ni
khro bo'i snang cha de nyid gzod ma'i klong chen rang rig gnyis su med pa'i ngang du ma bcos so ma lhug par bzhag
pa'o//
de'i ngang las 'gags med kyi 'char sgo khro bo'i rgyal po sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya'i skur sngar bzhin ldang
ngo*// ༈ //phur srung rnams la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/

a las byung ba'i bhañja'i snod du hūm̐ yig zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ha ho hrīḥ dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi mu ran skyong ba'i dam can 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ
sogs*/
na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu
sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/

rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor na// bstan pa srung mdzad g.yar dam can// shwa na sa bdag bdag nyid ma// skyes bu ging dang bka' sdod rnams// 'dir gshegs dam rdzas gtor ma dang*// mchod pa'i yo byad 'di snoms la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen bsam pa lhun grub ste// bkra shis bde legs ldan par mdzod//

ces pas phrin las bcol/ sras mchog kī la ya'i sgos sgrub phur srung gtor 'bul dang bcas pa 'di o rgyan bsam gtan dpal 'byor gyis/ rin po che'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gzungs thag me shel kha btags mthing mdog /atiñca 'brel ba sogs dngos bshams kyi bdog pa dang bcas bskul ba'i don du 'dzam gling rdo rjes bris pa'o/// /
